criminal_offences.name: Criminal Offences, Robbery & Physical Assault
criminal_offences.kannada_name: ಅಪರಾಧ ಕೃತ್ಯಗಳು, ದರೋಡೆ ಮತ್ತು ದೈಹಿಕ ಹಲ್ಲೆ
criminal_offences.hindi_name: आपराधिक अपराध, डकैती एवं शारीरिक हमला
criminal_offences.urgency_reason: Immediate physical safety, emergency medical examination (MLC), and prompt FIR registration under BNSS are critical to prevent loss of evidence and protect victim rights.

emergency_contacts.name: All-India Police & Emergency Services
emergency_contacts.details: Immediate police dispatch, ambulance assistance, and crime scene protection.

emergency_contacts.name: NALSA Free Legal Aid Helpline
emergency_contacts.details: Free legal aid counsel, victim advocacy, and DLSA representation under Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987.

emergency_contacts.name: National Health Helpline / Ambulance
emergency_contacts.details: Emergency trauma transport to nearest government hospital for Medico-Legal Care (MLC).

provisions.title: Robbery and Causing Hurt in Committing Robbery
provisions.description: Theft is robbery if in order to the committing of theft or in carrying away stolen property, the offender voluntarily causes or attempts to cause death, hurt, or wrongful restraint. Punishable with rigorous imprisonment up to 10 or 14 years.
provisions.simple_explanation: When theft of gold, cash, or valuables is accompanied by physical attack, threats, or injury, it legally constitutes the grave offence of Robbery.
provisions.official_source: Ministry of Law and Justice, Govt of India (India Code)

provisions.title: Voluntarily Causing Hurt or Grievous Hurt by Dangerous Weapons or Means
provisions.description: Whoever voluntarily causes hurt or grievous hurt by any instrument for shooting, stabbing, or cutting (including knives, daggers, or sharp weapons), punishable with imprisonment up to 3 to 10 years and fine.
provisions.simple_explanation: Attacking a victim with a knife, blade, or deadly weapon and inflicting physical injuries is a non-bailable, cognizable criminal offence.
provisions.official_source: Ministry of Law and Justice, Govt of India (India Code)

provisions.title: Lurking House-Trespass or House-Breaking by Night
provisions.description: Whoever commits lurking house-trespass or house-breaking by night with intent to commit an offence punishable with imprisonment, punishable with imprisonment up to 14 years and fine.
provisions.simple_explanation: Unauthorized forcible entry into a home by night with intent to commit robbery or assault attracts severe statutory punishment.
provisions.official_source: Ministry of Law and Justice, Govt of India (India Code)

provisions.act: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (formerly CrPC Section 154)
provisions.title: Information in Cognizable Cases (Mandatory First Information Report - FIR)
provisions.description: Every information relating to the commission of a cognizable offence shall be reduced to writing, signed by the informant, entered in book, and a copy given to informant immediately free of cost. Includes mandatory Zero FIR provision across any jurisdiction.
provisions.simple_explanation: Police are legally mandated under BNSS Section 173 to register an FIR for cognizable offences (like robbery and knife assault) immediately, and provide a free signed copy to the victim.
provisions.official_source: Ministry of Home Affairs / India Code

provisions.act: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (formerly CrPC Section 154(3) & 156(3))
provisions.title: Remedies when Police Station Refuses to Register FIR
provisions.description: If officer in charge refuses to record information, the aggrieved person may send substance of information by registered post to Superintendent of Police (SP). If unaddressed, private application lies before Judicial Magistrate.
provisions.simple_explanation: If the local police station hesitates or refuses an FIR, you have the statutory right to petition the District SP / DCP in writing or approach the Magistrate directly.
provisions.official_source: Ministry of Home Affairs / India Code

provisions.act: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (formerly CrPC Section 357A)
provisions.title: Victim Compensation Scheme
provisions.description: State Government in co-ordination with Central Government shall prepare scheme for providing funds for purpose of compensation to victim or dependents who have suffered loss or injury.
provisions.simple_explanation: Victims of violent crimes and severe physical injuries are entitled to statutory compensation from the District/State Legal Services Authority (DLSA/SLSA).
provisions.official_source: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA)

cyber_fraud.name: UPI & Cyber Financial Fraud
cyber_fraud.urgency_reason: Golden Hour (first 2-24 hours) is critical to freeze fraudster beneficiary accounts before withdrawal.

emergency_contacts.name: National Cyber Crime Helpline
emergency_contacts.details: Immediate account freeze through Citizen Financial Cyber Fraud Reporting System (CFCFRMS).

emergency_contacts.name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
emergency_contacts.details: Official MHA portal to file formal cyber complaints.

emergency_contacts.name: RBI Sachet Portal
emergency_contacts.details: For reporting unauthorized lending apps and illegal entities.

provisions.title: Cheating by personation by using computer resource
provisions.description: Punishment for cheating by personating using computer or communication device with imprisonment up to 3 years and fine up to 1 lakh rupees.
provisions.simple_explanation: Impersonating bank officials, lottery reps, or support agents via call, WhatsApp, or fake apps to steal money is a criminal offence.
provisions.official_source: MeitY / IT Act 2000

provisions.title: Punishment for identity theft
provisions.description: Dishonestly making use of electronic signature, password, or unique identification feature.
provisions.simple_explanation: Stealing OTPs, UPI PINs, or banking credentials to make unauthorized transactions.
provisions.official_source: MeitY / IT Act 2000

provisions.title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
provisions.description: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property punishable with imprisonment up to 7 years and fine.
provisions.simple_explanation: Financial fraud and cheating carries up to 7 years imprisonment under BNS 2023.
provisions.official_source: Ministry of Law and Justice, Govt of India

provisions.title: Customer Protection – Limiting Liability in Unauthorized Electronic Banking
provisions.description: Zero customer liability when unauthorized transaction occurs and customer notifies bank within three working days.
provisions.simple_explanation: If reported within 3 days, bank cannot hold customer liable for third-party fraud breach.
provisions.official_source: Reserve Bank of India

tenant_landlord.name: Tenant & Landlord Disputes
tenant_landlord.urgency_reason: Pre-litigation legal notice or DLSA mediation recommended before unlawful eviction or utility disconnection.

emergency_contacts.name: Emergency Police Services (Eviction/Threats)
emergency_contacts.details: Call 112 if landlord locks you out, threatens physical violence, or forcibly cuts water/power.

emergency_contacts.name: NALSA Legal Aid Helpline
emergency_contacts.details: Free legal representation and mediation through District Legal Services Authority (DLSA).

provisions.title: Security Deposit and Return
provisions.description: Security deposit for residential premises must not exceed two months' rent, to be refunded on vacating.
provisions.simple_explanation: Landlord cannot arbitrarily withhold security deposit after deducting agreed legitimate dues.
provisions.official_source: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

provisions.title: Withholding Essential Supplies & Eviction
provisions.description: Landlord cannot cut electricity, water, or access without authority. Eviction requires Rent Authority order.
provisions.simple_explanation: Illegal disconnection of water/electricity or locking out a tenant without a court order is strictly prohibited.
provisions.official_source: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

provisions.title: Duration of Certain Leases in Absence of Written Contract
provisions.description: Lease of immovable property terminable on part of either lessor or lessee by 15 days' notice in writing.
provisions.simple_explanation: Landlords must provide statutory written notice period before requiring a tenant to vacate.
provisions.official_source: Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice

provisions.title: Criminal Intimidation
provisions.description: Threatening injury to person, reputation, or property to cause alarm.
provisions.simple_explanation: If landlord threatens bodily harm or trespasses unlawfully, criminal complaint can be lodged.
provisions.official_source: Ministry of Law and Justice, Govt of India

consumer_complaint.name: Consumer Complaints & Defective Goods/Services
consumer_complaint.urgency_reason: Statutory 2-year limitation period applies. Fast grievance filing via NCH 1915 secures quick refund.

emergency_contacts.name: National Consumer Helpline (NCH)
emergency_contacts.details: Ministry of Consumer Affairs grievance redressal docket.

emergency_contacts.name: e-Daakhil Portal
emergency_contacts.details: Official e-filing portal for District, State, and National Consumer Commissions.

provisions.title: Definition of Consumer
provisions.description: Covers offline and online purchases across electronic commerce, direct selling, and retail.
provisions.simple_explanation: You have full consumer rights whether bought from physical shops or platforms like Amazon, Flipkart, Swiggy, etc.
provisions.official_source: Consumer Protection Act 2019

provisions.title: Deficiency in Service & Defect in Goods
provisions.description: Shortcomings in performance, warranty breach, non-functional electronics, or cancelled unrefunded services.
provisions.simple_explanation: Companies cannot sell defective goods or refuse replacements during warranty.
provisions.official_source: Consumer Protection Act 2019

provisions.title: Filing Complaint before District Commission
provisions.description: Consumer can file at home district commission for claims up to ₹50 Lakhs without needing an advocate.
provisions.simple_explanation: File complaints locally or online through e-Daakhil without paying heavy lawyer fees.
provisions.official_source: NCDRC

employment_salary.name: Employment & Unpaid Salary Disputes
employment_salary.urgency_reason: Statutory recovery of wages under Payment of Wages Act and State Shops & Establishments Act.

emergency_contacts.name: Shram Suvidha Portal
emergency_contacts.details: Ministry of Labour & Employment unified portal for labor inspections and complaints.

emergency_contacts.name: NALSA Legal Aid Helpline
emergency_contacts.details: Free legal representation for workmen and contract workers.

provisions.title: Claims arising out of deductions from wages or delay in payment
provisions.description: Application to the Labour Authority for recovery of delayed or unlawfully deducted wages with compensation up to 10 times.
provisions.simple_explanation: Employers cannot withhold earned wages without statutory cause. You can claim full salary plus penalty.
provisions.official_source: Ministry of Labour and Employment

provisions.title: Wrongful Dismissal & Retrenchment Procedure
provisions.description: Mandatory notice period or wages in lieu thereof, retrenchment compensation before termination.
provisions.simple_explanation: Sudden termination without notice pay or statutory compensation violates labor protections.
provisions.official_source: Ministry of Labour and Employment

provisions.act: State Shops and Commercial Establishments Act
provisions.section: Statutory Notice & Full and Final Settlement
provisions.title: Clearance of Dues upon Resignation/Termination
provisions.description: Full and final settlement including earned leaves and salary must be cleared within statutory period.
provisions.simple_explanation: Companies must settle all dues, experience letters, and PF clearance within designated timeframes.
provisions.official_source: State Labour Departments

property_disputes.name: Property & Land Disputes
property_disputes.urgency_reason: Risk of illegal possession or fraudulent conveyance requires timely injunction or police complaint.

emergency_contacts.name: Police Control Room (Trespass/Assault)
emergency_contacts.details: Call 112 immediately in case of armed trespass or boundary fence destruction.

emergency_contacts.name: Tele-Law / NALSA Free Legal Services
emergency_contacts.details: Pre-litigation property advice and revenue title inspection.

provisions.title: Criminal Trespass
provisions.description: Entering into or upon property in possession of another with intent to commit offence or intimidate.
provisions.simple_explanation: Illegal encroachment, breaking locks, or forcibly entering private land without title is criminal trespass.
provisions.official_source: Ministry of Law and Justice, Govt of India

provisions.title: Temporary and Perpetual Injunctions
provisions.description: Court order restraining opposite party from interfering with peaceful possession of property.
provisions.simple_explanation: Civil court can issue stay order/injunction to prevent demolition, construction, or illegal sale.
provisions.official_source: Legislative Department

provisions.title: Procedure where dispute concerning land or water is likely to cause breach of peace
provisions.description: Executive Magistrate jurisdiction to preserve possession and prevent violence over property boundaries.
provisions.simple_explanation: Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) can pass interim orders maintaining status quo to prevent clashes.
provisions.official_source: Ministry of Home Affairs

family_domestic.name: Family & Domestic Disputes
family_domestic.urgency_reason: Immediate safety from physical harm, protection orders, or emergency maintenance.

emergency_contacts.name: National Women Helpline
emergency_contacts.details: Emergency response, counseling, and shelter assistance for women facing abuse.

emergency_contacts.name: Emergency Police Services
emergency_contacts.details: Immediate police intervention for domestic assault or dowry harassment.

emergency_contacts.name: NALSA Legal Aid Helpline
emergency_contacts.details: Free legal aid counsel for women, children, and matrimonial disputes.

provisions.act: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
provisions.title: Application to Magistrate for Protection and Residence Orders
provisions.description: Aggrieved person can obtain immediate protection orders restraining abuser and securing right to reside in shared household.
provisions.simple_explanation: Court can order immediate stop to abuse, prevent eviction from family house, and grant monetary relief.
provisions.official_source: Ministry of Women and Child Development

provisions.act: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (formerly CrPC Section 125)
provisions.title: Order for maintenance of wives, children and parents
provisions.description: Magistrate order requiring person with sufficient means to pay monthly allowance for maintenance.
provisions.simple_explanation: Wife, minor children, and senior parents can claim monthly maintenance support.
provisions.official_source: Ministry of Law and Justice, Govt of India

provisions.title: Cruelty by husband or relatives of husband
provisions.description: Subjecting a woman to cruelty or harassment for unlawful dowry demands.
provisions.simple_explanation: Physical or mental cruelty, harassment, or dowry demands carry up to 3 years imprisonment.
provisions.official_source: Ministry of Law and Justice, Govt of India
